input_and_split: Train small saturated fixed-time endpoint only; lock large cup geometry.
observable_or_metric: Predicted 20-min volume, cm³; signed error; water-mass balance.
exclusion_or_gate: Do not fit an additional membrane + soil resistance to the same single observation.

input_and_split: Group by species; reserve 9 Sep in original stand.
observable_or_metric: Absolute conductivity error, m/(Pa s), compared to reported SD.

input_and_split: Use hydrostatic root-area value, not osmotic. Do not re-fit LEU03.
observable_or_metric: Predicted / reported Lp; state age, tissue and external resistance.
exclusion_or_gate: Field effective uptake vs seedlings/rinsed roots: an apparent mismatch is not a numerical error.

input_and_split: First two sites set wall input; keep two same-run sites unused.
observable_or_metric: Angle residual in degrees at held-out sites at each mesh.
exclusion_or_gate: Recalibrate numerical input when interface width or spacing changes.

input_and_split: Fix angle, liquid volume and geometry independently; select whole Fig. 11 measured series by material/gap.
observable_or_metric: Absolute force error vs gap; measured footprint; rupture and measurement scatter.
exclusion_or_gate: No fitted forces; compare total force only after finite axial span and ends are accounted for.

input_and_split: Use repeat unloaded scans and known rigid motion; preselect subset size away from moving interfaces.
observable_or_metric: Displacement bias, RMS and upper noise percentile in mm; valid fraction.
exclusion_or_gate: Synthetic subvoxel error is not the physical noise floor.

input_and_split: Prescribe measured tip motion; use independent material/parameter tests. Keep second specimen untouched, not a different time frame of the first.
observable_or_metric: Axial and outward displacement / tip advance vs distance / root radius; valid fraction and uncertainty.
exclusion_or_gate: Match time, register stationary frame, mask root and container at both times. Not a test of suction or growth rate if advance imposed.

input_and_split: Freeze tip geometry/tribology on other experiments; match Mephisto, density, moisture, 3–6 mm depth.
observable_or_metric: Measured force in mN and derived MPa; intact/decapped contrast with SE.
exclusion_or_gate: Compare 3D force to N, not a 2D per-length force. Do not double-weight force and derived stress.

input_and_split: Compare loose fine and coarse separately; keep soil preparation and scan pair.
observable_or_metric: Radius of above-bulk porosity in mm; porosity profiles.
exclusion_or_gate: Do not treat porosity radius as DVC displacement or read dense values from loose-sand data.

input_and_split: Tune dry mechanics elsewhere. Use Fallow P as unrooted comparison to Willow C, reserve Willow C responses.
observable_or_metric: Shear load/area and ux(z) at matched box displacement; filter DVC valid flag; inspect shear band.
readiness: Specimen states available; load/DVC files needed
exclusion_or_gate: Different soil states, no root growth and no pore-scale suction field. BUL20 and BUL22 Willow C are one sample.

input_and_split: Calibrate dry interface separately; reserve full wet suction series.
observable_or_metric: Peak/residual interfacial stress and slip at peak for each suction.
readiness: Suction settings entered; response curves not ingested
exclusion_or_gate: Imposed suction by itself is not a calibration observation.

input_and_split: Match root geometry, scale, confining state and water-conditioning history.
observable_or_metric: Force–displacement curves in consistent scale and units; peak, displacement, work.
exclusion_or_gate: Local bridge attraction cannot be validated directly by whole-root pull-out.

input_and_split: Measure advancing/receding separately on matched intact root or porous surrogate; include replicates.
observable_or_metric: Receding angle with CI, contact line vs time, wetted span.
exclusion_or_gate: Cuneo measured advancing bark angle, not a replacement measurement.

input_and_split: Same specimen geometry, same extracted volume history and actual gap; compare root uptake vs far-field drainage.
observable_or_metric: Paired force difference vs gap, local suction and wetted length; uncertainty on difference.
exclusion_or_gate: Set practical detection floor before testing. No fitted cohesion. Repeated points from one bridge are not replicates.

input_and_split: Condition separately on sand/loam, root diameter, and genotype.
observable_or_metric: Radial displacement and strain profiles; contrast localisation by substrate.
readiness: Paper trends; source data on request
exclusion_or_gate: Avoid treating bulk translation as local deformation; compare at equivalent spatial smoothing.
